name: Vela
description: How the Vela token files combine. Resolution order: the base set (every token, light values) then the `theme` modifier — `light` (the default) overlays nothing; `dark` overlays vela.dark.tokens.json, which re-points only the semantic colours that change. The spec prose disagrees with itself on `version` (2025-10-01 vs 2025-11-01); the published JSON Schema and Terrazzo both require "2025.10", which is used here.

base.description: Every Vela token with its light value: primitives, semantic colour, sizing, typography and motion.

theme.description: Light is the base; dark re-points the semantic colour layer onto other primitives.
